how.avd: markless_dragon_bugs (android-36 google_apis arm64-v8a), emulator console port 5560 (serial emulator-5560), launched -no-snapshot-save -no-audio -no-window -no-boot-anim
how.webview: com.google.android.webview 133.0.6943.137 (WebView provider); Chrome com.android.chrome 133 also installed
how.probe: APK built from /tmp/sysfont-measure/scripts/android (AndroidManifest.xml, src/dev/markless/sysfont/Main.java) with build-tools 36.0.0 (aapt2 link, javac --release 17, d8 --min-api 31, zipalign, apksigner), installed and run by /tmp/sysfont-measure/scripts/android.sh; raw output /tmp/sysfont-measure/out/android-paint.json; this fixture extracted by /tmp/sysfont-measure/scripts/fixture-android.mjs
how.method: new Paint(flags); setTypeface(tf); setTextSize(cssPx * density). runAdvance = getRunAdvance(text,0,n,0,n,false,n); textWidths = getTextWidths(text, float[]); runAdvancePrefix[i] = getRunAdvance(text,0,n,0,n,false,i); shaped = TextRunShaper.shapeTextRun(text,0,n,0,n,0,0,false,paint) glyph ids and x; fontMetrics = getFontMetrics. All lengths are device px; divide by density for CSS px.
how.paintFlags: byPaintFlags.default = new Paint() (flags as reported; hinted advances, integer-ish); byPaintFlags.linear = ANTI_ALIAS|SUBPIXEL|LINEAR_TEXT (unhinted advances, each glyph advance quantized to 1/64 device px). The linear variant is the closest to Blink: max |linear/density - Blink width| over the 6 strings x 5 sizes is 0.536 CSS px (Roboto 400), 0.725 (Roboto 700), 0.086 (Noto Serif 400), 0.098 (Noto Serif 700), 0.115 (Droid Sans Mono); see match-android.json.
how.blinkLineRule: line-height normal (device px) = round(-Paint.ascent) + round(Paint.descent) + round(leading=0), Paint at cssPx*density with ANTI_ALIAS|SUBPIXEL|LINEAR flags; CSS px = that / density. Inline box height equals line height. Canvas fontBoundingBoxAscent/Descent are round(ascent)/round(descent) at the CSS px size (canvas is not density-scaled).
how.boldFontNote: For weight 700 entries, PositionedGlyphs.getFont(i) reports /system/fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf weight 400 axes [wdth=100] (and NotoSerif-Bold.ttf for serif); the Roboto 700 weight is applied by the Typeface (variable font wght), as the widths show. Font.getMetrics vertical metrics of Noto Serif and Droid Sans Mono equal Roboto (ascent 0.9277 em, descent 0.2441 em).
how.trimmed: committed with only the fields the test reads: per typeface and size, its font file and axes, Chrome and WebView widths and line height, and per string the linear-text Paint run advance, glyph ids and x
